0022600027.text: The Cavaliers (4-4, sixth in the East) are on a two-game losing streak and have gone 3-1 at home and 1-3 on the road, while the 76ers (8-1, first in the East) have won five straight and are 8-1 in their last ten. Philadelphia beat Cleveland 114-106 in Philadelphia on October 22, so the Cavaliers trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after sweeping the 2025-26 series 4-0. Jaylon Tyson is out for Cleveland with an ankle sprain, and Jarrett Allen (knee) and Peyton Watson (hamstring soreness) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions, while Philadelphia will be without Adem Bona (back sprain), Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery) and Dominick Barlow (back fracture).
